name: Electrocute
doc: Electrocute (Quistis' Blue Magic, Electric Discharge adapted): the root and the main task - lightning crawlers over her model, free arcs from her centre, arcs from her bones to the targets with their sparks (a hit target tinted), the glow layouts, the screen flash, the sound; the action result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag275_electrocute_quistis.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and points in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Main
parts.doc: The crawlers over the caster, the free arcs, the arcs to the targets, the glow layouts, the flash, the sound; the action result at 44

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The discharge (main counter 0, at the caster)
